convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 indicators (iFractals, iRSI) with standard parameters. Simple entry/exit rules based on fractal breakout and RSI filter. Fixed lot position sizing with SL/TP. No external .mqh libraries for trading logic.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: negative Lots = fixed lot size, positive Lots = fraction of deposit

custom_logic_notes: RSI acts as a trend filter on entry: long entries require RSI below a threshold (oversold/bullish divergence zone) and short entries require RSI above a threshold (overbought/bearish divergence zone). Entry uses fractal breakout - price breaking above the last upper fractal triggers long, breaking below the last lower fractal triggers short. SL/TP values in pips are adjusted by multiplying by 10 when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001 (5-digit broker adjustment).
python_conversion_notes: Fractals require scanning historical bars to find the last valid upper/lower fractal value (many bars return no fractal). RSI is straightforward with talib or pandas_ta. The digit adjustment logic (multiply SL/TP by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be replicated. Position gate checks total open positions for the EA symbol and magic number. New bar detection uses static datetime comparison.
